incident_spec.summary: Investigating the performance and concurrency behavior of large transactions in PostgreSQL, focusing on row locking, transaction isolation levels, and blocking behavior.
symptoms: Blocked transactions when attempting to update rows locked by another transaction.
Potential serialization errors in higher isolation levels.
incident_spec.mechanism: PostgreSQL's MVCC (Multiversion Concurrency Control) and transaction isolation levels determine row visibility and locking behavior during concurrent transactions.

value.description: Reads do not block writes, and writes do not block reads.
Higher isolation levels may lead to serialization errors.
Transactions attempting to update locked rows are blocked until the locking transaction commits or rolls back.
